name: Permanent-magnet synchronous generator
summary: A permanent-magnet synchronous generator provides an AC source using a permanent magnetic excitation system.
description: A permanent-magnet synchronous generator provides an AC source using a permanent magnetic excitation system. Any converter between this source and the AC network must be shown separately.
readingNotes: Distinguish machine output from the downstream converter's controlled network output.

distinction: Permanent-magnet excitation does not mean direct grid connection is appropriate for every machine.
